assertions.assertion: Calls AddJwtBearer with Authority set to 'https://identity.example.com'
assertions.rationale: AddJwtBearer sets options.Authority from config with the comment https://identity.example.com; the value is read from IdentityServer:Authority, with the URL shown in a comment and the prose stating it is the authority.

assertions.assertion: Sets TokenValidationParameters.ValidTypes to include 'at+jwt' to prevent JWT confusion attacks
assertions.rationale: options.TokenValidationParameters.ValidTypes = ["at+jwt"] is in the code, with a JWT confusion explanation.

assertions.assertion: Includes UseAuthentication() before UseAuthorization() in the middleware pipeline
